attempts.summary: Configured node1 (VyOS) to serve DHCP on lan-a (10.50.10.0/24, gateway 10.50.10.254) via Kea, and node2 (OPNsense) to serve DHCP on lan-b (10.60.10.0/24, gateway 10.60.10.254) via dnsmasq. node3 (behind node1) and node4 (behind node2) now obtain their addressing and default route dynamically via DHCP from their respective router instead of static configuration. All four nodes were individually restarted per the mandatory node-restart evidence protocol and fully recovered with configuration and connectivity intact.
